system.description:
You lean into the assassin's half: Spellstrike is a tool for opening a fight on your terms, not sustaining one.

  • First Cut: if your target is unaware of you (surprised, or you have Advantage from Stealth) when you Spellstrike, it has Disadvantage on its save against that strike's spell. If a Levelled Spellstrike against an unaware target misses, the spell and its slot are not lost: you may deliver it with your next hit before the end of your next turn.
    • 9th level: First Cut also works against a creature that hasn't yet acted this encounter.
  • Quiet Blade: Advantage on Stealth checks in the round you Spellstrike.
